newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close higher, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close higher, more gains seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished higher on Tuesday as liquidity remained tight in the banking system and dealers expect further rises if the central bank fails to inject funds to ease liquidity on Wednesday.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.854 percent against Monday's 5.690 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.75-5.85 against 5.60-5.65. Dealers said the interbank rate may rise to above 6.00 percent on Wednesday.
The bond market reported no afternoon trade. Bond traders said market sentiment was bearish as the domestic economy showed no signs of recovery. -- Julie Hu (2-5080815)
